ideas.title: Credit Union Mergers and Name Changes: What They Mean for Your Account (2026)
ideas.why_now: This audit found two big 2026 mergers (First Tech + DCU, Ent + Wings), Meritrust + Premier Members, and six renames among the 100 CUs we cover; members searching their CU's new name land on stale pages elsewhere.

ideas.title: Standard vs. Promotional Certificates: Why Your Credit Union's 'Regular' CD Pays 1%
ideas.why_now: Verified rate sheets show standard 12-month certificates as low as ~0.70-1.95% at ICCU, Consumers, SDCCU, BECU and FourLeaf while their specials pay 3-4%+; readers need to know to ask for the special.

ideas.title: Credit Unions That Opened Membership to Everyone in 2026
ideas.why_now: This audit confirmed new open paths at Patelco, SDCCU, Truliant, Langley, Summit, St. Mary's Bank, Navigant, Coastal, EastRise and others; the anyone-can-join list grew from 17 to 30+.

ideas.title: Best Credit Union Rewards Checking Right Now (Connexus 4.50%, Consumers up to 5.00%)
ideas.why_now: Verified rate pages show rewards checking still paying 3-5% with conditions while regular savings sits near 0.05-0.25%; a requirements-by-requirements comparison is high-intent search content.

ideas.title: Are Credit Union Mortgage Rates Actually Lower? What 11 Rate Sheets Show
ideas.why_now: We now hold same-week verified 30-year APRs from 11 large CUs (6.92%-7.62%), enough for an honest, data-backed comparison piece.

ideas.title: Join a Credit Union With a Small Donation: Every $5-$25 Path We've Verified
ideas.why_now: This audit confirmed exact donation amounts on the credit unions' own pages (TTCU Cares $12+, Affinity Foundation $5, Bellco Foundation $5 paid by Bellco, Lake Michigan ALS $5, Wings foundation $5+); a single verified table is a strong how-to-join resource.

ideas.title: The $0 Tier: Credit Union Money Markets That Pay Nothing Below $1,000-$2,500
ideas.why_now: Verified rate sheets show 0.00% at the lowest money market tier at Navy Federal (under $2,500), Connexus (under $1,000) and Idaho Central (under $2,500); readers comparing headline APYs miss the minimum.

ideas.title: Credit Union New-Car Loan Rates Right Now: 4.99% to 5.89% at the Big Names
ideas.why_now: This audit re-verified new-auto APRs on 26 rate sheets: First Tech and Wright-Patt now start at 4.99%, while BECU rose to 5.89% and Idaho Central to 5.69%; car-buying season (year-end) is high-intent.
